# .github

> Org-wide defaults (issue/PR templates, CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, SECURITY) plus the building-block docs: BUILD-WITH-BLOCKS.md, BLOCKS-SCHEMA.md, blocks.schema.json and the workflow that validates every repo's blocks.json.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/.github/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/.github/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/.github/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [docs/BUILD-WITH-BLOCKS.md](https://github.com/Blockchains/.github/blob/main/docs/BUILD-WITH-BLOCKS.md): guide
- [docs/blocks.schema.json](https://github.com/Blockchains/.github/blob/main/docs/blocks.schema.json): schema
- [scripts/validate_blocks.py](https://github.com/Blockchains/.github/blob/main/scripts/validate_blocks.py): validator

## Related

- [Build with Blocks](https://github.com/Blockchains/.github/blob/main/docs/BUILD-WITH-BLOCKS.md): how to assemble projects from Blockchains repos
- [Org llms.txt](https://blockchains.github.io/llms.txt) · [blocks catalogue](https://blockchains.github.io/blocks.json)
- [Blockchains/blockchains.github.io](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchains.github.io): hub aggregates every blocks.json into /blocks.json
- [Blockchains/blockchainlab-sdk](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-sdk): example block
- [Blockchains/blockchainlab-mcp](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-mcp): example block
